question:
I, J, K, L, O, P and Q are sitting around a circular table, facing the centre of the table. P sits third to the left of K. O sits second to the left of J. Only K sits between Q and O. L is not an immediate neighbour of P.

How many people sit between I and O when counted from the right of I?
solution:

• O sits second to the left of J.
 
• Only K sits between Q and O.
 
• L is not an immediate neighbour of P.
